+import logging
+
+import pytest
+
+from structlog.stdlib import (
+    BoundLogger,
+    PositionalArgumentsFormatter,
+    ProcessorFormatter,
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("remove", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("event", "args", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("hello %(user)s", {"user": "Ada"}, "hello Ada"),
+        ("%(user)s/%(role)s", {"user": "Ada", "role": "dev"}, "Ada/dev"),
+        ("hello %(user)s", ({"user": "Ada"},), "hello Ada"),
+        ("%s %d", ("Ada", 3), "Ada 3"),
+        ("%s", ("Ada",), "Ada"),
+        ("literal %s", (), "literal %s"),
+        ("literal %(user)s", {}, "literal %(user)s"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_argument_forms(event, args, expected, remove):
+    original_args = args.copy() if isinstance(args, dict) else args
+    ed = {"event": event, "positional_args": args}
+    result = PositionalArgumentsFormatter(remove)(None, "info", ed)
+    assert result["event"] == expected
+    assert args == original_args
+    if remove:
+        assert "positional_args" not in result
+    else:
+        assert result["positional_args"] is args
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("remove", [True, False])
+def test_missing_and_none_arguments(remove):
+    processor = PositionalArgumentsFormatter(remove)
+    assert processor(None, "info", {"event": "literal %s"}) == {
+        "event": "literal %s"
+    }
+    assert processor(
+        None, "info", {"event": "literal %s", "positional_args": None}
+    ) == {"event": "literal %s", "positional_args": None}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("remove", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("structured", [True, False])
+def test_mapping_logging_pipeline(remove, structured):
+    messages = []
+    captured = []
+
+    def render(logger, name, ed):
+        captured.append(ed.copy())
+        return ed["event"]
+
+    class Handler(logging.Handler):
+        def emit(self, record):
+            messages.append(self.format(record))
+
+    processor = PositionalArgumentsFormatter(remove)
+    formatter = ProcessorFormatter(
+        use_get_message=False,
+        pass_foreign_args=True,
+        foreign_pre_chain=[processor],
+        processors=[render],
+    )
+    handler = Handler()
+    handler.setFormatter(formatter)
+    logger = logging.Logger("mapping-pipeline", logging.INFO)
+    logger.addHandler(handler)
+    args = {"user": "Ada"}
+    if structured:
+        bound = BoundLogger(
+            logger, [processor, ProcessorFormatter.wrap_for_formatter], {}
+        )
+        bound.info("hello %(user)s", args)
+    else:
+        logger.info("hello %(user)s", args)
+
+    assert messages == ["hello Ada"]
+    assert captured[0]["_from_structlog"] is structured
+    if remove:
+        assert "positional_args" not in captured[0]
+    else:
+        expected_args = (args,) if structured else args
+        assert captured[0]["positional_args"] == expected_args
+    assert args == {"user": "Ada"}
+
+
+def test_default_get_message_is_unchanged():
+    formatter = ProcessorFormatter(
+        processors=[lambda logger, name, ed: ed["event"]]
+    )
+    record = logging.LogRecord(
+        "mapping-default", logging.INFO, __file__, 1,
+        "hello %(user)s", ({"user": "Ada"},), None,
+    )
+    assert formatter.format(record) == "hello Ada"

spec.question:
Support dictionary-style interpolation throughout the standard-library processor integration. With ProcessorFormatter configured using use_get_message=False, pass_foreign_args=True, and foreign_pre_chain=[PositionalArgumentsFormatter()], an ordinary logging call such as logger.info('hello %(user)s', {'user': 'Ada'}) must render 'hello Ada', matching a structlog.stdlib.BoundLogger call whose processor chain includes PositionalArgumentsFormatter.

PositionalArgumentsFormatter must also support dictionaries supplied directly as positional_args, including dictionaries with one or multiple entries. Preserve support for single-dictionary tuples and ordinary positional tuples. Empty dictionaries and empty tuples must leave the event unformatted; the default remove_positional_args=True must still remove those argument fields. Missing arguments and positional_args=None must retain their current behavior. With remove_positional_args=False, retain the original argument object and representation after interpolation, without modifying the dictionary supplied by the caller. Keep ProcessorFormatter's default use_get_message behavior unchanged.

Return only a unified diff against non-test repository files.
